name: Conservative Income
headline: Earns on USDC in lending markets, and never holds anything else.
tradeoff: Gives up every source of return that is not an interest rate. A quarter to two fifths of the book sits in cash by rule, so it under-earns whenever lending pays well.
emphases: Rank markets by the depth behind the rate rather than the rate itself, and say which market was passed over and why.
Treat the cash floor as the product rather than as drag: write the mandate around what a depositor who may leave at any hour needs to find waiting.
Split across both lending venues by default, and state what concentration in a single market would have earned instead.
Optimise for the rate that survives a withdrawal wave, not the rate quoted at today's utilisation.
